title: SpiritVale
provenance: Reported by VrtZean (highball#200, 2026-09-25): the launch stops in the Easy Anti-Cheat and EOS bootstrap before the game starts. The game's 0.32.0.8 update added Linux support, where Proton loads EAC's Linux runtime.
notes: Anti-cheat: Easy Anti-Cheat. Proton's EAC support works through a Linux-native runtime (easyanticheat_x64.so) that Proton loads beside the game; there is no such runtime for Wine on macOS and Wine cannot load Linux libraries, so the bootstrap fails here whatever the engine. Only Epic can change that.

anticheat.note: EAC's Wine path is a Linux runtime Proton ships; nothing equivalent exists for macOS
